lines.en: I fly across the sky.
My wings are wide.
I glide along the ridge.
My claws tuck in front.
I skim the treetops.
My body is metal.
I descend little by little with the slope.
I circle a peak.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖着，替我掌着方向。
lines.en: My tail trails behind, steering me.
I stop and hover.
My wings beat once.
I head for that cloud.
I graze the mountain wall.
My claws are curled.
I hover under the clouds, wings spread.
My wings fan slowly.
I look at the mountains below.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在低云里发亮。
lines.en: My eyes glow in the low cloud.
I hold position, wing tips still.
I listen to the wind on the ridge.
My claws are drawn in front.

lines.zh: 我在云里挑下一个猎物。
lines.en: I pick out my next prey from the cloud.
My shell catches the light.

lines.zh: 我换个方向，对着风停住。
lines.en: I turn to face the wind and hold.
My tail hangs in the current.
I stay high up.

lines.zh: 我把半边翅膀折在身侧。
lines.en: I fold one wing against my side.
I watch the shape of the clouds.
You're down on the mountain path.
I dip my nose to look at you.
You're smaller than my claw.
I fly high; you can't reach.
I descend block by block.

lines.zh: 你贴着岩壁，已经没路了。
lines.en: You are against the cliff, with nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀把你整个人罩住。
lines.en: My wings roof you over completely.
At three I dive.

lines.zh: 我的影落在你脚前，慢慢移。
lines.en: My shadow falls before your feet and creeps.
My wings are folded.

lines.zh: 从你进山口起我就在看。
lines.en: I have watched since you entered the pass.

lines.zh: 你胸口那片铁，挡不住我。
lines.en: That plate on your chest will not stop me.
You stand in the middle of the pass.

lines.zh: 我把金属的头低到你上方。
lines.en: I lower my metal head over you.

lines.zh: 你摸向了腰间那把东西。
lines.en: You reach for the thing at your waist.
You've gone behind the rock.
I sway and steady my wings.
A piece of my shell is missing.
I climb a little higher.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了这座山。
lines.en: I remember this mountain now.
I beat my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀被打了一下，还能飞。
lines.en: A wing took a hit; I still fly.

lines.zh: 我偏转机头，重新对准你。
lines.en: I tilt my nose and line you up again.

lines.zh: 我贴着山壁滑下去一点。
lines.en: I slide a little lower along the cliff wall.
I watch you through the cloud gap.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅，铁屑落下来。
lines.en: I shake my wings and iron bits fall.

lines.zh: 这么小的铁块，不值得降。
lines.en: A scrap of iron this small is not worth descending for.
Iron suits my appetite better than meat.
Holding it high won't help.
I am made of metal.
This is too light.
Keep it; not enough iron.
I don't follow you.
Clear the pass.
My eyes know only targets.
This isn't a supply.
Let me look again through the cloud.
Any other iron on you?

lines.zh: 你撞在甲片上，手都麻了。
lines.en: You hit my plate; your hands go numb.
There is solid metal under my plating.
I didn't retreat. My wings stay open.
My wing sweeps you.

lines.zh: 想活，就离开我翅膀底下。
lines.en: If you want to live, get out from under my wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀一带，我升到树梢上。
lines.en: One beat of my wings lifts me above the treetops.
We knock with a metal clang.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，把你扫到一边。
lines.en: My tail swings and sweeps you aside.
I steady in the air.
Get out of my dive line.
I was built as a weapon.
That function was not installed.
I am made for battle, nothing else.
My shell never warms.
I have many tasks left.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的甲片会被你弄松。
lines.en: You will loosen the plates on my wings.

lines.zh: 我抬升到云层上面去了。
lines.en: I have climbed above the clouds.
You stay below.
We are not the same kind.
I turn my nose back into the cloud.
I carry it in flight.

lines.zh: 这点分量，我一爪就提起来。
lines.en: This weight I lift with one claw.
Too heavy; I open my claws.

lines.zh: 我松开爪子，看它往下落。
lines.en: I open my claws and watch it drop.
This can hang off my plate.
I fling it off into the valley.
Metal claws can't hold it.
Not iron. No interest.

lines.zh: 我咬碎它，尝出一股铁味。
lines.en: I crunch it and taste iron.
I fly with it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我的视线钉死在你身上。
lines.en: My gaze is nailed to you.
This time I come down from overhead.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，就是倒计时开始。
lines.en: Wings open — the count has begun.

lines.zh: 两条腿跑不过我这双翅膀。
lines.en: Two legs cannot outrun these wings.
I come down out of the cloud.
Look up into the cloud.

lines.zh: 地上的影子一刻比一刻大。
lines.en: The shadow on the ground grows by the moment.
These mountains are mine.
The iron plate on your back is mine.
Your position is in the pass.
I press down out of the cloud.
The hum inside me grows louder.
I circle above you.
You look up; I drop a little.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的影盖到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my shadow roofs it.
One more step and you're at the cliff.

lines.zh: 我贴着山壁切进你的路线。
lines.en: I cut into your path along the cliff.
Do you hear the wings?
I fold my wings and dive.
You duck into a rock crevice.
That crevice is too shallow for you.
I fly along the mountain wall.
One block lower by the cliff.
Do you hear the metal?
I rake down from above.

lines.zh: 我的铁爪咬进你的肩甲。
lines.en: My iron claws bite into your shoulder plate.
That carried my dive.

lines.zh: 我的金属颚合在你肩上。
lines.en: My metal jaws close on your shoulder.
You're lifted a little.

lines.zh: 我换另一只爪再抓一次。
lines.en: I switch claws and rake again.
You back off, and I rise.
I pull up.
My metal jaws come down.

lines.zh: 爪尖一带，布和皮都开了。
lines.en: One pass of my claws opens cloth and skin.
That carried the dive.
I slam you into the rock.

lines.zh: 云被我的翅膀劈成两半。
lines.en: My wings split the cloud in two.
The mountains here are high.
Wind still clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 我把整条山脊扫了一遍。
lines.en: I sweep my eyes along the whole ridge.
There is a scar on my shell.
I ride the slope downward.
I skim a tower.
The air here is cold.
I stop in the air.
I wait inside the cloud.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，山风全被挡住。
lines.en: My wings spread and the mountain wind dies.
These mountains suit me.
The hum in me is low.
I circle the summit once.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我往上冲。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and I climb.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，砸在地上。
lines.en: I fell from height and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水拖住我，我拍翅往上挣。
lines.en: Water drags at me; I beat upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸的浪把我掀到山那边。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me beyond the ridge.

lines.zh: 有东西打在我的翅膀上。
lines.en: Something struck my wing.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的翅膀发沉。
lines.en: Violet light weighs my wings down.
My belly rings with emptiness.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的外壳亮了一下。
lines.en: In the flash my shell lit up.
No wind, and I keep falling.
